title: Qt: Make sure the main display filter history always updates
description:
Run the filterPackets routine through the main display filter entry
just as as done with setDisplayFilter, so that the main display
filter entry is the single source for filtrs and all filters applied
to the entire capture file enter the history.

Move the routine that actually applies the filter to a protected
slot that is connected to the main display filter signal by the
main window itself, so that other routines use the appropriate
slots intead.

This means that (currently?) the "force" parameter for a new
filter is not respected (filters are always forced), but the check
in file.c for forcing is not necessarily correct anyway because
it looks at the filter text and not what it compiles to.

Fix #21031

\*\* (wireshark:333163) 09:56:37.931841 \[(none) WARNING\] ui/qt/wireshark_main_window.cpp:1856 -- tryClosingCaptureFile(): Refusing to close "test/captures/dtls13-dsb.pcapng" which is being read.

\*\* (wireshark:333163) 09:57:51.065316 \[(none) WARNING\] ui/qt/wireshark_main_window.cpp:1856 -- tryClosingCaptureFile(): Refusing to close "test/captures/dtls13-dsb.pcapng" which is being read.

Please let me know if you need me to dig deeper with the debugging and collect addional logs
Yes, sorry, somehow the change to one file got left out of the pushed change even though it was in my working directory. Fix inbound
No problem, now master builds and runs fine on my machine, thank you.
